fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded checkpoint on the truck driveway ~150m in from Cranbury Station Road (~40.3063,-74.5001): a guard booth in a center median island with barrier arms extending across the inbound and outbound lanes — clear controlled entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small booth with a distinctive pyramidal roof set in the median island between the two truck lanes, beside the barrier arms. Distinct from the DC building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: 1 inbound lane through the gate (single barrier arm); 1 outbound. The booth sits in the median between them.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Standard single-lane-each-way gate; no notable unused paved width or extra lanes for an express bypass.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The truck driveway curves ~150m from the public road to the gate, then opens into a deep truck court — holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with dock banks and trailers backed in on both long faces (N and S), physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock with dock doors along both ~600m long building faces — well over 50 doors. Count is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dense rows of detached trailers in drop lots on both the N and S truck courts — 50+ band; one of the highest trailer densities observed.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Cranbury NJ Exit 8A logistics corridor — a dense, continuous belt of large distribution buildings along the NJ Turnpike. Urban industrial fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from the fenced/developed footprint (building + both truck courts + drop lots); landscaped buffer parcel is somewhat larger.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved driveway width outside the gate where a truck can hold; modest stacking room.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved yard inside the gate before the dock aprons.
